profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Atlas HXM

positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and built the backend services for LegalZoom’s Experts World, Goldengate, and Legal Agreements Service using Kotlin, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL.

 • Built the core operational backbone for LegalZoom’s tax, IP, legal plans, and order fulfillment systems.

 • Created the workflow engine that tracks progress and connects customers with legal experts over web, phone, and messaging.

 • Owned the day-to-day tech stack—set up our event-driven architecture with Kafka, handled DB migrations with Flyway, and ran microservices on Kubernetes.

 • Led legacy modernization projects to clear out tech debt and keep the platform fast under heavy traffic.

 • Served as the main point of contact for production incidents, root-cause debugging, and pipeline stability.

 • Partnered with product managers to scope new features, mentored engineers, and improved internal tooling so the team could ship code faster.

positions.title: Software Engineer 3
positions.description:
• Engineered and scaled core microservices for Fandango’s backend, handling massive ticket-buying spikes during major nationwide movie releases.

• Led the integration of Braintree payment processing and migrated legacy payment data, wiping raw credit card data from internal databases to hit strict PCI compliance.

• Refactored old legacy code and added extensive unit testing and automation, cutting down production bugs and making deploys much safer.

• Acted as a core maintainer for production stability, keeping the platform up and running during heavy peak traffic events.

• Worked directly with product managers, QA, and frontend devs to scope out backend architecture and build new platform features.

• Reviewed code across the team to keep security tight, codebase clean, and architectural standards consistent.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
• Built core backend microservices and API features for Fandango's high-traffic ticketing platform.

• Promoted to Software Engineer 3 to lead larger payment and platform architecture initiatives.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Built and maintained core backend systems powering the ticket bidding, seat allocation, and payment processing engines.

 • Debugged and resolved complex bugs across the entire order lifecycle to keep customer transactions reliable.

 • Designed and built automated test suites from scratch to validate pricing algorithms, bidding workflows, and third-party payment integrations.

 • Expanded automated test coverage across regression suites, catching critical issues early and making releases much safer.

 • Created end-to-end test plans and worked closely with dev teams to catch quality and logic bugs earlier in the build process.

positions.title: Software Engineer in Test III
positions.description:
• Built, maintained, and executed automated test suites for core backend systems, pricing algorithms, and checkout flows.

 • Researched and introduced automated testing best practices across the engineering team to expand code coverage and catch bugs before release.

 • Jumped into complex, multi-system bugs to troubleshoot logic issues, debug edge cases, and report actionable fixes to devs.

 • Created end-to-end test plans and drove quality upstream, ensuring new features were fully verified before going to production.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built real-time interactive apps and broadcast graphics software used live on-air for major events like the NFL, NCAA, MLB, and the Olympics.

 • Created custom iPad apps (Objective-C) and C#/.NET UI tools that let on-air presenters and operators directly control live graphics during live broadcasts.

 • Wrote custom C++ plugins and VizArtist/VizTrio scripts to push dynamic graphics, real-time sports data, and custom visualizations to the screen.

 • Developed internal control panels and dashboards using ASP.NET MVC, HTML, CSS, and jQuery to streamline production workflows for broadcast crews.

 • Worked directly with producers, designers, and live-event engineers on tight deadlines to build software that couldn't fail on national TV.

positions.title: Web Programmer
positions.description: Web Development (HTML / PHP / CSS / MYSQL / Javascript)

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
• Built a prototype LSAT prep iPhone app from scratch using Xcode and Objective-C.

 • Wrote the code to parse questionnaire data, display interactive quiz questions, and score user responses in real time.

 • Worked directly through the full iOS build cycle—from mobile app architecture and UI layout to testing on device.
